summary: DigiAsia Corp. filed a Form 6-K on May 15, 2026, reporting entry into definitive agreements to sell its wholly owned subsidiary DigiAsia Bios Pte Ltd to Brainstorm Consulting Private Limited (a PayMate India Limited subsidiary) in a multi-step transaction. Under the Share Purchase Agreement, DigiAsia will sell 100% of DigiAsia Bios to the Purchaser in exchange for 99.60% equity consideration at first close, then transfer Purchaser shares to PayMate for approximately 49% of PayMate's fully diluted share capital at second close. The first close must occur within 60 business days; the second within 30 business days after. Conditions include regulatory approvals, funding, and voluntary shareholder approval. Watch for regulatory clearances and funding confirmation—risk-arb centers on cross-border approval and financing.
